description: Build a cited brief across videos on the server with a free LLM (map-reduce for large collections). Every claim cites a video, timestamp and quote that were checked against the transcript; points are marked consensus (two or more videos agree), disputed (both sides cited) or single-source, and claims that failed the check are listed separately, uncited. If you can read the transcripts yourself, the `brief` prompt is cheaper and usually better; use this for collections too large for your context.

format.description: markdown (default): the brief as Markdown; json: the full Brief object

question.description: What the brief should answer, e.g. "Which G-Wagon year should I buy?"

template.description: brief (default) or buyer-guide, tutorial-steps, comparison, summary

urls.description: Up to 25 video URLs or ids

name: build_brief
title: Build a cited brief
